title: Panera Bread Brings Back Pumpkin Spice - Plus New Fall Drinks and Bakery Items - NewsBreak
text:
By Michael Carpenter ,
7 hours ago Panera Drops New Fall Bakery and Beverage Lineup Panera Bread has launched its fall 2026 menu, bringing back pumpkin spice favorites and introducing new coffee drinks and bakery items available now at bakery-cafes nationwide. More Eat & Drink News
Pumpkin Spice Drinks Returning to Panera This Fall
Two pumpkin spice coffee drinks are back on the menu after their seasonal absence:
Pumpkin Spice Latte: Freshly brewed espresso with foamed milk and pumpkin spice sauce, topped with whipped cream and pumpkin spice crumbles. Iced Pumpkin Spice Latte: The same ingredients as the classic latte, served over ice. New Pumpkin Spice Beverages for Fall 2026
Panera is adding two new drinks to the fall lineup, including one on its Frozen Java platform:
Pumpkin Spice Iced Coffee: Dark roast coffee with pumpkin sauce over ice, topped with sweet cream cold foam and pumpkin spice crumbles. Pumpkin Spice Frozen Java: A frozen blended coffee drink with dairy blend and pumpkin sauce, topped with whipped cream and pumpkin spice crumbles. New Panera Bakery Items Available This Fall
Two new baked goods join the menu alongside a returning seasonal treat:
Pumpkin Cinnamon Roll: Sweet dough stuffed with cinnamon and pumpkin filling, topped with pumpkin spice icing. Caramel Pumpkin Slice: A cake slice with pumpkin pie spices, brown sugar, vanilla, and salted caramel swirls, topped with pumpkin spice icing. Pumpkin Cookie (returning): A pumpkin-shaped shortbread cookie decorated with icing. How to Order Panera’s Fall Menu
The fall lineup is available for dine-in, delivery, Rapid Pick-Up®, or drive-thru. Customers can also join MyPanera® to earn rewards on fall orders. Orders can be placed through the Panera Bread app or at PaneraBread.com .
Source: RestaurantNews.com
